recommendation.primary: Use each exact current edited r1 movie as the video-to-video source, modifying outfit/environment only. Keep the bound r3 narration untouched; ignore or discard provider-produced audio.
recommendation.crop_boundaries: If the provider cannot preserve an existing hard crop change, divide the actual footage at the recorded crop boundaries and rejoin with identical frame counts. Do not invent replacement hand/body/head performances.
recommendation.higher_resolution: Available 1920x1080 restored masters are the same source performance before crop. They are an option only with exact listed frame-window/crop reconstruction; the final 1280x720 r1 clips remain the reference for preservation.
recommendation.P01: Preserve r1 restored start 7, not original alignment start 13. That six-frame slip is part of the current picture.
recommendation.P12_P13: P12 spans seg072/seg073 and P13 spans seg074/seg075. They share continuous underlying takes; preserve continuity and original segment/crop boundaries.
recommendation.P08_exception: Current P08 has no moving performance for the corrected words. Old 549-frame P08 is incompatible with locked 343-frame corrected narration. Keep the still or separately resolve that exception; a look-only transfer cannot create a matching performance.
recommendation.validation: Compare frame-corresponding original/output face, hands, body/head poses and crop boundaries, exact duration/frame count and locked audio. Appearance-transfer ability is not established by this inventory.
